title: group mcast rejects spec CIDR prefix strings
description:
## Problem

spec/12-apps.md 18.8.3 writes mesh prefixes as 0200:1234:5678:9abc::/64. unicast_prefix_based_mcast / group_multicast_from_id type-hint prefix as IPv6Address | IPv6Network | str.

_native_prefix64 only special-cases IPv6Network objects. A CIDR string goes through to_ipv6 -> IPv6Address and fails:

AddrError: Unexpected '/' in '0200:1234:5678:9abc::/64'

Host strings without /64 (0200:1234:5678:9abc::) and IPv6Network objects work. Tests never pass a CIDR string.

## Why it matters

Callers copying the spec prefix form get an error. Same /64 expressed three ways (CIDR str, host str, IPv6Network) should yield one RFC 3306 address.

## Where

python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:192-202 _native_prefix64
python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:205-242 unicast_prefix_based_mcast, group_multicast_from_id
design: _native_prefix64 should parse str with a prefix length as IPv6Network, not IPv6Address. Keep the host-address path (packed[:8] of a 0200::/8 unicast) for strings without '/'.
acceptance_criteria: unicast_prefix_based_mcast and group_multicast_from_id accept '0200:1234:5678:9abc::/64' and IPv6Network('0200:1234:5678:9abc::/64') with the same packed output as the spec template ff35:0040:0200:1234:5678:9abc::1 for group 1. Non-/64 CIDR still raises AddrError. Existing host-address and IPv6Network tests stay independent-oracle.
